title: Hold The Line, Andy
style: latin rap-rock crossover, 104 BPM, live kit pocket, bongo percussion, distorted electric guitar, heavy 808 sub-bass, punchy kick, halftime bounce, call and response hook, crowd chant hook, rap lead verse, three-part vocals, spoken word intro, plate reverb, parallel compression, wide stereo mix, protest anthem, absurdist wit
lyrics:
[Intro]
No long calls, no runaround
Set him up right, lock it down
[Verse 1]
Andy Mac on the line, trying to keep it clean
Too many steps in between what he needs and what he means
One account, one login, one clear way through
Less phone time, more real work to do
[Pre-Chorus]
No man down, not today
We build the stack and clear the way
No confusion, no delay
Set him up right and let him play
[Chorus]
Set him up right, Andy Mac
One clean path, no looking back
We care in action, not in talk
Build the lane and let him walk
[Verse 2]
Drummer hands, steady mind, still carrying load
Need the tools to match the road
Corey in the corner saying “we got this done”
Help him help himself, that’s how we run
[Pre-Chorus]
No man down, not today
We build the stack and clear the way
No confusion, no delay
Set him up right and let him play
[Chorus]
Set him up right, Andy Mac
One clean path, no looking back
We care in action, not in talk
Build the lane and let him walk
[Bridge]
Account ready
Stack ready
One step now
Then he’s steady
[Final Chorus]
Set him up right, Andy Mac
One clean path, no looking back
Real help, real time, real track
Set him up right, Andy Mac
[Outro]
No man down.
Stack ready.
